items.evidence: Log shows a fresh tip per well, 40 uL beads aspirated from A1 of beads_reservoir and dispensed into each of 96 wells, then 10 mix cycles. The 'Incubate sample_plate 5 min' comment precedes the magnet comment.
The 'Engage magnetic module; wait 5 min' comment is present. The log shows 90 uL aspirated from each well to waste, then two rounds of 200 uL ethanol added and 200 uL removed to waste per well.
Air-dry and 'Disengage magnetic module' comments appear in order. 50 uL water is added per well with 10 mix cycles of 40 uL. The comment 'Incubate 2 min; then re-engage magnetic module' follows.
Log lines 6530-6911 show 45 uL aspirated from each sample well and dispensed into the same well on elution_plate (A1->A1 through H12->H12).
Every transfer uses new_tip='always'; the log shows a pick up and drop tip around each well for supernatant, ethanol removal and elution, with no cross-well tip reuse.

judge.summary: The protocol performs every step with correct volumes, wells and order, and records each manual step with protocol.comment. A fresh tip is used per well throughout, so all five rubric items pass.
